product.name: Aurelio ThermoSense 4.1
product.description: The Aurelio ThermoSense 4.1 is a compact, wall‑mounted thermostat designed for efficient home climate control. It supports dual‑band Wi‑Fi 802.11ac and Zigbee 3.0 for seamless integration with existing smart hubs. The device offers programmable schedules, real‑time temperature monitoring, and an intuitive touchscreen interface. Energy usage can be tracked via a companion app, providing insights for cost savings. The unit is built with a durable polycarbonate housing and silicone seals to ensure longevity in varied indoor environments. It is suitable for both new installations and retrofit projects in residential settings.
